issues.where: far background and skyline, upper left to centre (region 6)
issues.what: a shows a cool blue-grey haze with a soft, low hedgerow and blurred plants. b has a clear grey mountain ridge with a band of warm amber bokeh under it, so the place reads as a different location
issues.fix: remove the defined ridge and amber band and bring back the soft, cool, hazy low treeline of a

issues.where: foreground left and mid-ground, both sides of the plant
issues.what: b adds several large out-of-focus grass blades at the left edge, two sharp blades with dew at mid-left, and a grass clump at the right. a has only one tall thin blade at the far left edge, and the mid-ground there is bare soil
issues.fix: remove the extra blades and clump and keep only the single tall blade at the far left, as in a

issues.what: in a the seed coat is crusted with soil, has broad grey-white stripes, and is split to show the green cotyledon, with soil crumbs falling from it. In b the coat is clean and darker, with fine stripes and only a thin yellow-green seam, and nothing falls
issues.fix: add soil crumbs to the coat, widen and lighten the stripes, open the split to show more cotyledon, and bring back the falling soil

issues.what: a is cooler, with teal-blue shadows, a pink-peach sky and deep black soil. b is pushed warm amber-brown through the mid-ground, and its soil blacks are lifted to brown
issues.fix: cool the shadows toward teal, deepen the soil blacks, and pull the amber out of the mid-ground

issues.where: soil mound around the stem base
issues.what: b builds a raised, sharply detailed mound of round clods in the centre and lights it warm. a has broad, wet, glinting clods spread across the frame, with many small specular sparkles and bokeh points
issues.fix: flatten the mound into a spread of clods and add back the wet speculars and bokeh glints across the foreground soil

issues.where: region 4, sun and sky round it
issues.what: a's sun has a strong starburst with rays fanning down-left and an orange glow along the horizon. b's sun is a soft disc with faint rays, and the sky around it is flat beige
issues.fix: restore the starburst rays and the warm orange horizon glow under the sun

issues.what: a's stem has dense, fine, backlit hairs with dew beads and soil clumps on it. b's stem is smoother, with sparse short hairs and a few clean dark specks
issues.fix: thicken the rim-lit hair fringe and add dew beads and soil clumps on the stem

issues.what: a's sky goes from teal-blue to pink-peach near the horizon. b's sky goes from blue to grey-beige with no pink, and a grey ridge band sits low in it
issues.fix: warm the lower sky toward pink-peach and remove the grey ridge band

issues.what: a has a fine film grain and a photographic texture. b is clean and smooth and looks rendered
issues.fix: add matching fine grain and a little texture irregularity

issues.what: a shows a dark teal hillside and treeline with clear silhouette detail and good contrast. b replaces it with a low-contrast grey misty ridge
issues.fix: darken and cool the hillside toward teal and bring back the treeline silhouette and its contrast

issues.where: grass in mid-ground and on the right
issues.what: a has a sparse right-hand grass clump full of dew sparkles and bokeh, and a thin blade at mid-left. b has a dense clump of long, arching blades on the right with few sparkles, plus a new cluster of sharp blades just left of the seed shell
issues.fix: thin the right-hand clump back to a's sparse, dew-sparkling blades and remove the added blades next to the shell

issues.what: a has a glowing low ground mist lit by the sun across the mid-ground, over dark soil with cool green-grey bokeh. b has a warm amber-brown bokeh band and no glowing mist
issues.fix: add back the sunlit ground mist and cool the mid-ground bokeh

issues.what: a's leaves are a rounded, soft-sheened mid green with rim-lit hairs and sparse dew. b's leaves are more saturated, sit slightly larger and higher to the right, and are covered evenly in bright white dot droplets that look stamped on
issues.fix: lower the saturation, remove most of the uniform dots and keep only a few irregular dew beads, bring back the edge hairs, and match a's leaf size and position

issues.what: a's stem is pale yellow-green with a soft backlit hair fringe. b's stem is a darker grey-green covered in white bead dots
issues.fix: lighten the stem toward pale yellow-green and replace the bead dots with a fine rim-lit hair fringe

issues.where: region 4, sun and sky round it
issues.what: a's sun sits low, with a strong starburst and an orange horizon glow behind dewy grass. b's sun is a soft disc with weak rays over a flat beige sky
issues.fix: restore the starburst rays and the orange horizon glow

issues.what: a's foreground soil is deep black with scattered wet glints and bokeh. b's soil is lifted to brown and is sharply detailed and lit warm, with few speculars
issues.fix: deepen the soil blacks, soften the near clods, and add the wet glints back

issues.what: a's sky is pale blue-grey above and turns pink-peach near the horizon. b's sky is bluer and greyer, with no pink, and it fades into a grey haze band
issues.fix: warm the lower sky toward pink-peach

issues.what: a has fine film grain. b is grain-free and looks rendered
